title: Isopiestic studies of aqueous solutions at elevated temperatures VII. MgSO4 and NiSO4
authors: H. F. Holmes, R. E. Mesmer
experimental_method: High-temperature isopiestic method: solutions in titanium cups equilibrate with a common vapour phase in a sealed pressure vessel; molalities from in-situ weighing with an electromagnetic balance; NaCl(aq) reference; 383.14 K and 413.22 K.
uncertainties_stated: Isopiestic molalities accurate to 0.25 per cent or better; for molalities above 1.0 mol/kg the last digit is not significant; masses to +/-0.2 mg.
quality_remarks: Irreversible solubility effects (MgSO4 and NiSO4 precipitating) prevented measurements above 413.22 K; at 413.22 K MgSO4 was in solution only at the two highest water activities (2 MgSO4 points). At 383.14 K three loadings agreed well. Rows with a dash in the MgSO4 column are kept but carry no MgSO4 datum. Temperature scale not stated.
